labels.label: risk
labels.reason: It announces removed beta APIs, removed in-tree volume plugins, and a mandatory Ginkgo timeout change, all of which can break upgrading deployments or test pipelines.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The --service-account-api-audiences flag was removed, so configurations using it must switch to --api-audiences.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Ginkgo.Measure is deprecated only inside the Kubernetes e2e test framework and still works, so it does not affect application or deployment users.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Kube-controller-manager flags deleting-pods-qps, deleting-pods-burst, and register-retry-count were removed, so any configuration using them will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Kubeadm upgrade now rewrites a legacy k8s.gcr.io imageRepository to registry.k8s.io, a behavior change that operators need to know about.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Users who disabled UnversionedKubeletConfigMap must manually copy the kubelet-config ConfigMap before upgrading, which is required migration work.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Kubeadm no longer applies the master NoSchedule taint to new control plane nodes, and existing taints must be removed during upgrade, which changes scheduling behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Kubelets no longer support the alpha seccomp annotations and static pods can no longer use them, so workloads relying on them must migrate to securityContext.seccompProfile.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The gcp and azure auth plugins were removed from client-go and kubectl, so clusters relying on them need an external credential plugin.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The PodSecurityPolicy admission plugin is removed, so clusters using it must migrate to PodSecurity admission or another policy webhook before upgrading.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: In-tree vSphere volumes are unsupported on vSphere releases below 7.0u2, so users on older vSphere must upgrade their environment.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Windows winkernel kube-proxy no longer supports HNS v1 APIs, which can affect Windows node deployments on older HNS versions.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The GlusterFS provisioner is deprecated but still functions in this release, so it is a warning with no required action yet.
